parameters.jsCode:
// Render the approved brief as a plain-text email. Only verified items are here.
const b = $json.brief || {};
const d = $json.briefDate || '';
const storyLines = (b.topStories || []).map((s, i) =>
  (i + 1) + '. ' + s.title + '
   Why it matters: ' + (s.whyItMatters || '') + '
   ' + s.url
).join('

');
const leadLines = (b.jobLeads || []).length
  ? (b.jobLeads || []).map(l => '- ' + l.title + ' at ' + (l.company || '') + ' — ' + (l.why || '') + '
  ' + l.url).join('
')
  : 'No fresh job leads in today's sources.';
const learn = b.learnToday
  ? b.learnToday.topic + ' — ' + (b.learnToday.why || '') + '
' + b.learnToday.url
  : '—';
const body = 'Good morning, Siva — your AI brief for ' + d + '

' +
  'TOP 5 STORIES
' + storyLines + '

' +
  'JOB LEADS
' + leadLines + '

' +
  'ONE THING TO LEARN TODAY
' + learn + '

' +
  '—
Researched, written and reviewed by your multi-agent brief workflow. ' +
  'Every item links to its source.';
return [{ json: { ...$input.first().json, emailBody: body } }];

parameters.content:
## Multi-agent Daily Brief — setup
1. Create the Google Sheet (tabs: Briefed Log, Skipped, Errors) — see SETUP.md.
2. Connect credentials: Gmail OAuth2, Google Sheets OAuth2, Google Gemini API.
3. Paste your Sheet ID where marked YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID.
4. Click Execute with Manual Trigger first. Only then activate the schedule.

## Three agents, one brief
- RESEARCHER: RSS feeds → filter → dedupe (no AI).
- WRITER: Gemini agent drafts the brief from the research pack only.
- REVIEWER: separate Gemini agent fact-checks the draft, drops unverified items, sends it back once at most.
- Final Source Check is mechanical (no AI): every URL must exist in the fetched items.
Hard rules: no invented news, no fake job leads, no Internshala, never send an unreviewed draft.

## Credentials — read before importing
Multi-agent Daily Brief — credentials: none are set in this file. On import n8n shows 'No credential set' — connect your own Gmail OAuth2, Google Sheets OAuth2 and Google Gemini API. (The original file carried placeholder credential references that made n8n refuse to save on import; they were removed.)
Google Sheets ID: replace YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID in the Sheets nodes.
